answer: As the dawn breaks on a decentralized network, Sybil resistance mechanisms come into play. One such mechanism is the 'Proof of Work' (PoW) canyon, where AI agents must expend computational resources to solve complex puzzles, thereby demonstrating their commitment and authenticity. This process makes it costly for attackers to create fake identities, as each new Sybil requires solving a new puzzle, much like a falcon must constantly prove its hunting prowess to claim its territory.
